test_read_sas_from_file: test pd.read_sas to read a SAS7BDAT file with utf-8 encoding and return a DataFrame
test_read_sas_from_buffer: test pd.read_sas reading a SAS7BDAT file from a BytesIO buffer with iterator mode
test_read_sas_iterator_chunks: test pd.read_sas iterator mode reading SAS7BDAT files in chunks with rdr.read(n)
test_read_sas_pathlib: test pd.read_sas accepting a pathlib.Path object as the file path argument
test_read_sas_chunksize: test pd.read_sas with chunksize parameter iterating over SAS7BDAT file chunks
test_read_sas_encoding_infer: test pd.read_sas with encoding='infer' to auto-detect SAS file encoding
test_read_sas_zero_variables: test pd.read_sas raises EmptyDataError when SAS file has zero columns
test_sas7bdat_reader_class: test SAS7BDATReader class with convert_header_text option for raw column names
test_sas_date_datetime_handling: test pd.read_sas correctly converts SAS date and datetime values to pandas datetime types
test_rle_rdc_decompression_errors: test pd.read_sas propagates RLE/RDC decompression errors from corrupted SAS files
